_comment: Vendored snapshots of the three layer wrappers' .github/workflows/swift-ci.yml, byte-for-byte at the commit below. Point-in-time evidence, not a live sync: test-verdict-inventory.py builds the committed verdict-inventory.json from these bytes plus this repository's own live swift-ci.yml, and a drift test catches the LOCAL file changing out from under the committed inventory. A wrapper edit in its own repository does not retrigger this repository's CI; re-vending these three files (and re-running the builder) is a manual step the next lane touching this area must perform. TX9 (swift-institute/.github#276) re-vended all three from main after the wrapper reductions landed (ci-ok aggregate, integrated-docs pass-through, and swift-docs.yml deleted; matrix is each wrapper's only job).
